responsibility: Declares the public target state and utility interfaces for GCC’s RTL GCSE/PRE/CPROP subsystem, most notably the per-target x_can_copy mode table used to determine whether plain register copies are supported and the gcse_or_cprop_is_too_expensive and gcse_cc_finalize helpers. This header provides the module-level contract shared by gcse.cc, cprop.cc, and related RTL global optimization code.
same_name_distinction: Acts as the small shared header for the GCSE subsystem, unlike gcc/gcse.cc which contains the full PRE/hoisting implementations. It mainly exposes target_gcse state such as x_can_copy plus cross-module helpers like gcse_or_cprop_is_too_expensive and gcse_cc_finalize for users such as cprop.cc and gcse.cc itself.
